title: Kononenkogroup hero
description: A window-sized hero: one photo filling the screen edge to edge, with a two-line white title at the bottom left whose last word turns serif. The title lines rise from their masks on load; the photo drifts down by a fifth of the window as the hero scrolls away.
notes: the title is white (dark-scope foreground) because it sits on a photo; a placeholder shows a muted surface
pair with the fixed kononenkogroup-header, which overlays it
CSS only: the parallax is scroll-driven and simply doesn't happen without support
